user.title: Set up Sonoff SWV
user.description: Select the Sonoff SWV-ZFE device as registered by Zigbee2MQTT/MQTT. The stable IEEE address will be extracted automatically and used to link existing MQTT entities.

error.device_not_found: The selected device could not be found in the device registry. Please try again.
error.not_a_zigbee2mqtt_device: The selected device does not look like a Zigbee2MQTT device (no matching MQTT identifier found). Please select the Sonoff SWV device registered via Zigbee2MQTT.

abort.already_configured: This Sonoff SWV device is already configured.
